The Minutes of a Called Meeting of the City Council.
Austin, Oct. 1, 1887.
Hon. J.W. Robertson, Mayor, presiding.

Roll Call. Present Aldermen Brush,
Cummings, Fisher, Graham, Jones, Platt,
Phillips, Walker, Warren, Wollmer - 10.
Absent- Aldermen Alexander, Anderson, Caldwell, Campbell, Metz, Odell, Schneider, Schuber,
To consend Wortham - 10.

Call of Council. Alderman Walker moved a call of the Council, which was duly seconded and
adopted.

Excused. Alderman Cummings moved to excuse Alderman Anderson, Alexander, and Schuber on
account of Sickness. Adopted.

Ald. Wortham. Alderman Wortham Came in.

Suspend Call. Alderman Phillips moved to Suspend the Call. Adopted.

Adjourn. Alderman Wortham moved to adjourn. Lost yeas 5; Nays, 6.

The The following Call was then read:
Austin Tex. Oct. 1, 1887.

Call. Hon. J.W. Robertson, Mayor:
"We, the undersigned Aldermen,
hereby request that you Call a special meeting of the City Council to Consider the
question of the Sale of lots in Greenwood Cemetery, today, October, 1, at 4 p.m.
C.E. Fisher, J.W. Phillips, R. Platt, J.E. Jones, Geo. A. Brush, J.W. Graham, T.J.
Campbell, J.P. Schneider, C.S. Metz.
The Call is made as requested above.
J.W. Robertson, Mayor.

Ald. Odell. Alderman Odell Came in.

Greenwood Alderman Fisher introduced the following: "A resolution Cemetery. Suspending the
Sale of lots in Greenwood Cemetery.
Be it Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, That the City Assessor and
Collector be and he is hereby instructed not to sell or offer for Sale any lot or lots in
Greenwood Cemetery.
This resolution shall take effect and be in force from and after its passage."

Ald. Came in. Aldermen Metz, Schneider and Caldwell Came in.

Amendment. Alderman Graham moved to amend the Resolution
